description: The MH-47 RTO, also known as the Mumbai North or Dahisar RTO, was established to decongest the Andheri RTO (MH-02). It serves the northernmost western suburbs of Mumbai, managing vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and permit services for one of the city's most densely populated residential corridors.
address: Dy. Regional Transport Officer, Wing-A, Link Road, Kandarpada, Anand Park, Dahisar West, Mumbai
